article.articleTextExcerpt: Commercial 1 min read Brookfield India REIT, NCW acquire three floors in Godrej BKC, Mumbai Brookfield India REIT and NCW’s Prime Offices Fund have completed the acquisition of Parthos Properties through a 50:50 joint venture. Parthos owns and operates the second, third and fourth floors of Godrej BKC in Mumbai. Ankit Sharma ETRealty Published On Sep 30, 2026 at 07:25 AM IST NEW DELHI: Brookfield India Real Estate Trust and NCW’s Prime Offices Fund have completed the acquisition of 100% of Parthos Properties, which owns and operates three office floors in Godrej BKC, Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai.The acquisition was completed through Parthos One, a company owned equally by Brookfield India REIT and NCW.The 100% acquisition of Parthos, on a fully diluted basis, was completed on September 29, 2026 from Project Diamond Holdings (DIFC) and Project Cotton Holdings One (DIFC).As part of the transaction, Brookfield India REIT had acquired 100% of Parthos One’s equity share capital from its existing shareholders on September 23.
